argument: The nine unequal deposits and the empty middle must read as a composed material constellation before they read as an interface. No single body may carry the image.

With readout, controls, hint, labels, and prose hidden, the blind view must leave v050's relief, v052's vacancy register, and v053's membrane. It should read as pieces that share a production rule, not as a target diagram.
The visitor must bend pressure from one seam to another. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and deterministic relay control must offer equivalent meaningful paths; no hover-only action may carry the work.
An accepted relay must move, tilt, or rescale every deposit. A line, colour shift, status, or selection cannot substitute for distributed geometry.
Same-seam, weak, and straight gestures must remain geometry-neutral. The bend is a real pressure condition in the engine, not an annotation.
Four transfers must compound in one ledger. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding constellation and release must return to the deterministic quiet field.

Generated inline SVG paths, gradients, produced relay curves, and DOM pointer events are the medium. No screenshot, external font, imported illustration, brush library, or Canvas 2D body carries the work.

p5.brush is translated from material production rules into a detached pressure relay. Brush presets, watercolor, hatching, grain, source palette, composition, code, examples, and API surface are refused.

v054 changes representation, composition, encounter, memory, medium, and viewer task: a detached SVG constellation and bent two-seam relay replace the recent Canvas 2D bodies, registers, and continuous membrane.
Delete v054 if hiding witnesses leaves a generic scatter, if the relay line is the only evidence, if any deposit remains fixed, if order is cosmetic, or if exact lifting fails.
